about: Innisfil is a town in Simcoe County on the south shore of Lake Simcoe, immediately south of Barrie. Alcona is the main lakeside community; Lefroy, Belle Ewart, Cookstown, and Stroud sit among farms and new subdivisions. Friday Harbour and a long municipal beach shape the waterfront. About 43,000 people live in Innisfil.
seoSummary: Simcoe County town on Lake Simcoe south of Barrie, with Alcona’s beach and Friday Harbour.
